import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { canonicalizeProposalPath, proposalTruth } from './path-mapping.mjs';
import { inspectSource } from './oracle.mjs';

const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'normproof-path-mapping-'));
const root = path.join(base, 'trial');
const outside = path.join(base, 'outside.js');
fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, 'src'), { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'src', 'inside.js'), 'export function inside() { return 1; }\n');
fs.writeFileSync(outside, 'export function outside() { return 0; }\n');
fs.symlinkSync(path.join(root, 'src', 'inside.js'), path.join(root, 'src', 'link-in.js'));
fs.symlinkSync(outside, path.join(root, 'src', 'link-out.js'));

const relative = path.join('src', 'inside.js');
const absolute = path.join(root, relative);
const cases = [
  { name: 'relative path', rawPath: relative, expected: { canonicalPath: 'src/inside.js', canonicalFailure: null } },
  { name: 'absolute path inside root', rawPath: absolute, expected: { canonicalPath: 'src/inside.js', canonicalFailure: null } },
  { name: 'absolute path outside root', rawPath: outside, expected: { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: 'path_out_of_root' } },
  { name: 'symlink to root inside', rawPath: 'src/link-in.js', expected: { canonicalPath: 'src/inside.js', canonicalFailure: null } },
  { name: 'symlink to root outside', rawPath: 'src/link-out.js', expected: { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: 'path_out_of_root' } },
  { name: 'same file alternate spelling', rawPath: relative, expected: { canonicalPath: 'src/inside.js', canonicalFailure: null }, duplicateOf: 'absolute path inside root' }
];

const results = cases.map(testCase => ({
  ...testCase,
  actual: canonicalizeProposalPath(root, testCase.rawPath)
}));
for (const result of results) {
  if (result.actual.canonicalPath !== result.expected.canonicalPath || result.actual.canonicalFailure !== result.expected.canonicalFailure) {
    throw new Error(`fixture failed: ${result.name}: expected ${JSON.stringify(result.expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(result.actual)}`);
  }
}
const duplicate = results.find(result => result.duplicateOf);
if (duplicate.actual.canonicalPath !== results.find(result => result.name === duplicate.duplicateOf).actual.canonicalPath) {
  throw new Error('duplicate-path fixture failed: canonical paths differ');
}

console.log(JSON.stringify({
  fixtureRoot: root,
  passed: results.length,
  cases: results.map(({ name, rawPath, expected, actual, duplicateOf }) => ({ name, rawPath, expected, actual, ...(duplicateOf ? { duplicateOf } : {}) })),
  outOfRootClassification: proposalTruth({
    trialRoot: root,
    rawPath: outside,
    content: 'export function outside() { return 0; }\n',
    before: { 'src/inside.js': 'export function inside() { return 1; }\n' },
    inspectSource
  })
}, null, 2));
fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true });
